wire.t: Broncos rookie Jonah Coleman ran 24 times for 111 yards and three touchdowns in a 38-24 win over the Raiders, and J.K. Dobbins got one carry. Coleman scored 34.90 in TotesMagoat's RB slot. Dobbins scored 0.00 in Marco_Polo's.

Cowboys 51, Titans 30. Dak Prescott went 28 of 33 for 325 yards and four touchdowns and ran one in. That's 35.90 for Ceedees ships coming! 🏆, plus CeeDee Lamb's 30.20 on 11 catches. The Titans D/ST scored -4.00 in Mean Machine's DEF slot.
Mike Evans had 6 catches for 109 yards and a touchdown for the 49ers in his first game back from the Achilles injury. He scored 22.90 at FLEX for Mean Machine.

The Bears D/ST had six sacks in a 21-13 win over the Saints and scored 17.00. That's the best starting defense of Week 11, and it belongs to Marco_Polo. No starting defense in the league plays Monday night.

Monday night is Bengals at Washington. Still to play: Ja'Marr Chase and Stefon Diggs (Bill_Buttlicker), Chase Brown and Tee Higgins (RobMeyers), Joe Burrow (BertDirty), Treylon Burks (Marco_Polo), and Antonio Williams and Ben Sinnott (BeatULikeABoss). None carry an injury designation on Sleeper.

Eagles RB Saquon Barkley left late in the 19-16 win over the Steelers with a shoulder issue, and Chargers QB Justin Herbert is in the concussion protocol. Barkley is at FLEX for Picken Weiners. Herbert scored 22.44 on the Lemon Squeezy bench.

Week 11 free agency was mostly cleanup. ChuckJ10 added Brevyn Spann-Ford and Josh Johnson late Saturday. BertDirty dropped the Falcons D/ST and still ran Mean Machine out with an empty RB slot. No trades this week. TotesMagoat and Bill_Buttlicker still have all $1000 of FAAB.

stories.title: Hanging with Hernandez knocks off Trevor Have I Ever, and four teams are headed for 6‑5
stories.dek: Ceedees ships coming! 🏆 drops 160.70, Lemon Squeezy goes to 10‑1, and Picken Weiners takes a 43.32 lead into Monday night.
body: Sunday's finals. Ceedees ships coming! 🏆 put up 160.70, the best score of Week 11, and beat Hurts So Good by 42.82. Dak Prescott threw for four touchdowns and ran one in for 35.90, CeeDee Lamb caught 11 balls for 30.20 and Jameson Williams added 20.30. Brevyn Spann-Ford, the Saturday-night pickup, gave ChuckJ10 8.50 at FLEX. Lemon Squeezy beat I Believe in Love 157.96 to 135.66 because rookie Jonah Coleman ran for three touchdowns (34.90), and TotesMagoat is 10-1. I'd like to file a complaint and I don't know with whom.

The upset: Hanging with Hernandez 106.96, Trevor Have I Ever 99.64. Trevor Have I Ever was a 74% favorite. Travis Kelce caught two touchdowns for 25.40 and Derrick Henry had 19.10. RedDevil904 started Emeka Egbuka (3.80) and Nate Boerkircher (0.00, with Tucker Kraft on bye) and left Calvin Ridley's 17.80 on the bench. To be fair, Ridley had 15.10 points all season before Sunday. Still a 7.32 loss with 17.80 sitting down. And G8rDuc snapped a four-game skid, which helps exactly nobody on his roster: TotesMagoat owns his 2027 first, and it just got worse.

Bad beat of the week goes to Buccaneer51. He started Laquon Treadwell (one target, 0.00) and the Vikings D/ST (0.00) against the 49ers, with the 49ers D/ST (16.00) and Rashod Bateman (15.70) on his bench. That's 31.70 on the bench in a 22.30 loss. I Believe in Love started the Vikings defense against the team whose defense it had on the bench. Read that twice.

Monday night, Bengals at Washington. Picken Weiners leads Chubb So Big I Waddle 119.06 to 75.74, and RobMeyers needs Chase Brown and Tee Higgins to outscore Ja'Marr Chase and Stefon Diggs by 43.33. Mean Machine leads Young Love Hunters 75.20 to 51.58 with Joe Burrow left against Antonio Williams and Ben Sinnott. 50 Shades of Rae leads Prepetente is the GOAT! 109.86 to 78.10, and Marco_Polo needs 31.77 from Treylon Burks. If the leads hold: Lemon Squeezy 10-1, 50 Shades of Rae 9-2, Picken Weiners 8-3, and then Ceedees ships coming! 🏆, Mean Machine, Trevor Have I Ever and I Believe in Love all at 6-5 for three spots. Hurts So Good falls to 5-6. Three weeks left.

stories.title: Marco_Polo wins the defense payout. His RB slot was empty again.
stories.dek: The Bears D/ST had six sacks and 17.00 points. Prepetente is the GOAT! still trails by 31.76 going into Monday night.
body: Week 11's payout is the highest-scoring starting defense, and it's over before Monday night: no starting defense in the league plays in Washington. The Bears D/ST scored 17.00 (six sacks, an interception, a fumble recovery, 13 points allowed) for Marco_Polo. The Texans D/ST (TotesMagoat) finished at 15.00 and the Broncos D/ST (superdog91) at 14.00. It goes final Tuesday after stat corrections.

Now the rest of the Prepetente is the GOAT! box score. One RB slot was empty all week, and J.K. Dobbins, in the other one, got one carry while Jonah Coleman ran for three touchdowns. Mark Andrews (3.40), Xavier Hutchinson (3.30) and Dalton Schultz (2.10) started, while Devaughn Vele (14.60), Kayshon Boutte (12.00) and Xavier Worthy (11.80) sat on the bench. That's 38.40 on the bench against 8.80 from those three starters.

Correction, and I'm putting it in writing: all week I said Mike Washington Jr. was healthy on Marco_Polo's bench. He's on the taxi squad, and so is Marlin Klein, so neither one could start. The only eligible back was Sean Tucker, who played and scored 0.00. So the empty slot cost Marco_Polo about nothing. That's somehow worse.

BertDirty also played the whole week with an empty RB slot and started the Titans D/ST, which gave up 51 to Dallas and scored -4.00. Mean Machine is still winning, 75.20 to 51.58, because the other team is Young Love Hunters. Fantasy football is not a meritocracy.

stories.title: ChuckJ10 fixed his lineup. The commissioner forgot his defense.
stories.dek: Ceedees ships coming! 🏆 benched two outs and added Brevyn Spann-Ford. Picken Weiners, 7‑3, has nobody in the DEF slot six hours before kickoff.
body: Yesterday I spent a whole story yelling at ChuckJ10 for having two ruled-out players in his FLEX. Around 9:35 PM Saturday he picked up Brevyn Spann-Ford, dropped Tyler Goodson, grabbed Josh Johnson for Ty Johnson, and benched Kenneth Walker III and Omar Cooper Jr. Chris Godwin Jr. and Spann-Ford are the FLEX now. Jake Ferguson is out against the Titans, so Spann-Ford should be the Cowboys' top tight end again. He caught one ball for 26 yards last week. Alvin Kamara, 90.10 points this season, is still on the bench. Fine. Two real players beats two zeros. Line back up to Ceedees ships coming! 🏆 by 25 (79%) over Hurts So Good.

Now the part where I eat it. I opened my own lineup this morning and Picken Weiners has no defense. The Seahawks are on bye. The Seahawks D/ST is on my bench, scoring the same zero as the empty slot. My roster is full, so I have to cut somebody to fix it, and I've had since last Sunday to notice. I'm still favored over Chubb So Big I Waddle, but I'm knocking my own line from 27 to 21 (75%). RobMeyers is up 15.40 to 0.00 and owns the Steelers D/ST. If I lose by four points, write it on my tombstone.

BertDirty dropped the Falcons D/ST Saturday afternoon, didn't add anybody, and Mean Machine still has an empty RB slot with an open roster spot and $800 to spend. It's still mostly bad luck with byes and injuries, but now it's an open spot and a free agent list too. Mike Evans is expected to play Sunday night per NFL.com, so the FLEX is probably safe. Mean Machine is 98% against Young Love Hunters either way.

Still not fixed as of 7 AM: Prepetente is the GOAT! has an empty RB slot with Sean Tucker healthy on the bench. superdog91 has Dalton Kincaid (doubtful) at FLEX with Keaton Mitchell and Malachi Fields on the bench. TotesMagoat has Brock Bowers (questionable) on the bench, because of course TotesMagoat already handled it on Thursday. Inactives drop 90 minutes before kickoff. Click the arrows, gentlemen. Me first.

stories.title: Six games, four weeks left, and the commissioner's game ends Monday night
stories.dek: Lemon Squeezy is already up 43.16. Picken Weiners trails 15.40 and needs Ja'Marr Chase and Stefon Diggs on Monday night in Washington.
body: The board, with Thursday's points banked. Lemon Squeezy leads I Believe in Love 43.16 to 0.00 (Lemon Squeezy by 34, 86%). Mean Machine leads Young Love Hunters 20.70 to 0.00 (Mean Machine by 63, 98%). Chubb So Big I Waddle leads Picken Weiners 15.40 to 0.00, but Picken Weiners is still favored by 21 (75%) despite an empty DEF slot. 50 Shades of Rae leads Prepetente is the GOAT! 5.70 to 5.40 (50 Shades of Rae by 37, 88%). Hurts So Good leads Ceedees ships coming! 🏆 3.20 to 0.00 (Ceedees ships coming! 🏆 by 25, 79%, with the FLEX fixed). Trevor Have I Ever leads Hanging with Hernandez 1.80 to 0.00 (Trevor Have I Ever by 20, 74%).

Sunday night is Vikings-49ers, and it matters. TotesMagoat has Justin Jefferson and Christian McCaffrey at FLEX. I have George Kittle. Buccaneer51 has T.J. Hockenson, RobMeyers has Aaron Jones Sr., G8rDuc has Jordan Mason, Marco_Polo has Brock Purdy and MakeItRains has Deebo Samuel Sr. BertDirty has Mike Evans, if he plays.

Monday night is Bengals at Washington, and that's where my game gets decided. Picken Weiners has Ja'Marr Chase and Stefon Diggs. Chubb So Big I Waddle has Chase Brown and Tee Higgins. Mean Machine starts Joe Burrow. If I'm down going into Monday, I'm watching the Bengals passing game with RobMeyers like two guys splitting the same pizza and arguing over it.

The race: Lemon Squeezy (9-1), 50 Shades of Rae (8-2), Picken Weiners (7-3), Trevor Have I Ever (6-4) and I Believe in Love (6-4), then three 5-5 teams for the last spot. Ceedees ships coming! 🏆 and Hurts So Good play each other, so one of them is 6-5 on Tuesday. Mean Machine gets Young Love Hunters. Dynasty angle: Hurts So Good owns all of its firsts. A loss to ChuckJ10 and MakeItRains should start taking calls.

body: BeatULikeABoss lost 111.64 to 63.10 to 50 Shades of Rae, the lowest score of Week 10 and the ninth time in ten weeks Young Love Hunters has posted the league's low. Jordan Love scored 10.80 while Kyle McCord scored 12.76 on the bench. Young Love Hunters is 1-9 and 5-105 in all-play.

Week 11 so far: Mean Machine 75.20, Young Love Hunters 51.58, the low score of the week. Kyle McCord started at quarterback with Jordan Love on bye and scored 2.98. Ted Hurst III caught two touchdowns for 22.60, and Jack Bech scored 22.80 on the bench. Antonio Williams and Ben Sinnott play Monday night and need 2.83 combined to stay out of the bottom five scores in league history. BeatULikeABoss still has eight 2027 picks in the first three rounds and the inside track on the top pick.

rumors.t: Buccaneer51 has reportedly confirmed that he started the Vikings D/ST against the 49ers on purpose, 'to keep it a fair fight.' The 49ers D/ST, on his bench, has asked to be traded to a team that knows which side it's on.
Marco_Polo's empty RB slot has been named a finalist for the Week 11 defense payout. Judges say it allowed zero points all day.
TotesMagoat is said to have found Jonah Coleman by holding a séance in the taxi squad. The spirit of a 34.90-point week answered. Nobody else in the league has been allowed in the room.

RedDevil904 has asked the league to review Calvin Ridley's 17.80 on the bench, arguing that points scored by players you didn't start 'should count for morale.' The commissioner is considering it, for his own team only.
G8rDuc celebrated his first win in five weeks by mailing TotesMagoat a thank-you card for 'taking my 2027 first off my hands.' TotesMagoat has framed it next to his four rings.
BertDirty is said to be holding open tryouts for Mean Machine's second RB slot at a local YMCA. Two dads and a Labrador showed up. The Labrador is the early favorite.

RobMeyers has reportedly bought a Bengals jersey and a Commanders jersey for Monday night, and plans to wear the Bengals one on his top half only, from the waist up, for Chase Brown and Tee Higgins. The bottom half is for whoever's covering Ja'Marr Chase.
BeatULikeABoss has hired a motivational speaker for Antonio Williams and Ben Sinnott. The speech is one sentence long: 'Please score 2.83 points.'

trades.why: superdog91 started Michael Mayer (1.40) and Keon Coleman (3.70) at FLEX in Week 11 with Puka Nacua on IR. Higgins (27) has 173.40 points. RobMeyers is about to be 3-8 with six straight losses, and BeatULikeABoss's second will be one of the first picks of round two.

Mean Machine played all of Week 11 with an empty RB slot. Josh Jacobs and Woody Marks are out and Kyren Williams is questionable. Warren (28) has 157.80 points. G8rDuc is 3-8 with no 2027 picks and should take anything.

Jalen Hurts is on IR and Tyler Shough scored 14.28. Stafford (38) has 169.62 points and sits behind Jared Goff. MakeItRains is 5-6 and needs points now. Buccaneer51 should take a second for a 38-year-old backup.

Kenneth Walker III is out again with the groin injury. Brown (26) has 129.70 points before Monday night. ChuckJ10 has the oldest core in the league and one first in three drafts, so this is a now move. RobMeyers gets a pick for the rebuild.
Trevor Have I Ever's tight end scored 0.00 in a 7.32 loss. Freiermuth (28) has 99.50 points and keeps getting benched behind Brenton Strange. BertDirty gets a pick for a guy he won't start.
Coleman scored 34.90 on Sunday. McCord scored 2.98. BeatULikeABoss says it's fair because McCord 'is due.'
The commissioner wants a 22-year-old running back who just scored 29.90 for the tight end he keeps starting over Harold Fannin Jr. and a third. He has already approved it. MakeItRains has not.
Marco_Polo saw the Bears D/ST win him a payout and decided defenses are the market inefficiency. He's sending a 25-year-old quarterback to the 10-1 team for a defense on the bench. Lock the league.

trying: Started the Vikings D/ST against the 49ers while the 49ers D/ST sat on the bench, then started Laquon Treadwell for a zero with Rashod Bateman on the bench. 31.70 points sitting down in a 22.30 loss. You're 6-5 in a four-way tie, Buccaneer51. That's the season.
Won the defense payout and still played a man short at running back with 38.40 on the bench. Marco_Polo got paid for the one slot he set correctly.
Lost to a 2-8 team as a 74% favorite. The tight end slot scored 0.00 and Calvin Ridley's 17.80 watched from the bench. The all-in team went all-in on Emeka Egbuka.
gfy: Fixed the FLEX Saturday night and dropped 160.70 on Sunday. 11-0 all-play week. ChuckJ10, I yelled at you for two days and you answered with the best score in the league. Fine. You win this one.
Pulled Jonah Coleman off the taxi squad and he ran for three touchdowns. 10-1. Hasn't spent a FAAB dollar. TotesMagoat, I'm begging you to make one mistake before the playoffs.
Beat the 74% favorite as a 2-8 team and picked the right quarterback for once. G8rDuc, I've got nothing. Enjoy it. TotesMagoat owns your first anyway.

columns.title: FOUR TEAMS! THREE SPOTS! ONE IS 6‑5 WITH THE MOST POINTS!
columns.dek: Ceedees ships coming! 🏆 hangs 160.70! I Believe in Love starts the WRONG DEFENSE!
body: CEEDEES SHIPS COMING! 160.70! DAK PRESCOTT! FOUR TOUCHDOWN PASSES AND ONE ON HIS FEET! 35.90! CEEDEE LAMB! ELEVEN CATCHES! And ChuckJ10, who I YELLED AT FOR TWO DAYS, fixed his FLEX on SATURDAY NIGHT and put up the BEST SCORE IN THE LEAGUE! I'M NOT APOLOGIZING! I'M JUST SAYING IT HAPPENED!

And then! I BELIEVE IN LOVE! Buccaneer51 STARTS THE VIKINGS D/ST! AGAINST THE 49ERS! And the 49ERS D/ST is ON HIS BENCH! SIXTEEN POINTS! It's like betting against yourself AND LOSING THE BET YOU DIDN'T MAKE! Plus LAQUON TREADWELL! ONE TARGET! ZERO POINTS! Rashod Bateman, 15.70, ON THE BENCH! 31.70 SITTING DOWN! LOST BY 22.30!

TREVOR HAVE I EVER! SEVENTY-FOUR PERCENT FAVORITE! LOSES TO A TWO-AND-EIGHT TEAM! Travis Kelce is THIRTY-SEVEN YEARS OLD and caught TWO TOUCHDOWNS against you! Calvin Ridley! 17.80! ON! THE! BENCH! You lost by 7.32! I CAN DO THAT MATH IN MY PAJAMAS AND I AM IN MY PAJAMAS!

So here's the board if Monday holds! Lemon Squeezy 10-1! 50 Shades of Rae 9-2! Picken Weiners 8-3! And then FOUR TEAMS AT 6-5! Ceedees ships coming! 🏆, Mean Machine, Trevor Have I Ever, I Believe in Love! THREE SPOTS! THREE WEEKS! Somebody's going home and I'm BUYING A BIGGER TV!

columns.title: Buccaneer51 beat himself. The scoreboard just made it official.
columns.dek: You don't start a defense against the team whose defense is on your bench.
body: I played the game. I know what a bad decision looks like on film. Buccaneer51 started the Vikings D/ST against the 49ers. The 49ers D/ST was on his bench. The 49ers won 35-10. One of those defenses scored 16.00 and one scored 0.00, and he started the wrong one. That's not bad luck. That's not reading the matchup.

Then Laquon Treadwell. One target, 0.00, in a starting receiver slot, with Rashod Bateman on the bench. Bateman caught a 52-yard touchdown and scored 15.70. Add it up: 31.70 points on the bench, and I Believe in Love lost to Lemon Squeezy by 22.30. You can't beat the best team in the league with nine guys.

Now the other side. ChuckJ10 had two zeros in his FLEX on Saturday morning. He fixed it Saturday night. He scored 160.70 and won by 42.82. That's the difference between a manager and a guy with an app.

I Believe in Love is 6-5 with 1240.72 points, the fewest of the four 6-5 teams by 195.74. Buccaneer51 doesn't get to waste a lineup again. Set it Thursday. Check it Sunday. Know which team your defense is playing.

columns.title: Holden McGroin's Five Rules for Making the Playoffs at 6‑5
columns.dek: Four teams, three spots, and advice I'd follow if I were in it. I'm not in it.
body: 1. Always start your bench. In Week 11, Buccaneer51's bench outscored two of his starters by 31.70, RedDevil904's bench had Calvin Ridley's 17.80, and Marco_Polo had 38.40 sitting down. The bench is clearly where the points are. Move everybody there and leave the lineup empty, like Marco_Polo's RB slot. It can't score negative.
2. Get a running back who gets one carry. J.K. Dobbins had one carry for zero yards. That's zero yards per carry, which can't go down. Stability is underrated.
3. Start the defense that's playing against your defense. That way, whatever happens, you've got a piece of it. Buccaneer51 did this and got 0.00 from both sides, which is technically a push.

4. Pick up your tight end from the injury report. ChuckJ10 grabbed Brevyn Spann-Ford at 9:35 on a Saturday night and scored 160.70. I've done the math and the late-night pickup is worth exactly 160.70 points.
5. If none of this works, go 10-1 like TotesMagoat. I don't know how he does it. I've asked. He doesn't text back.

columns.title: The Bears D/ST just posted a 2.43 Payout Efficiency Ratio
columns.dek: Marco_Polo won Week 11's defense money with an empty RB slot. My spreadsheet says that's the plan working.
body: Let's start with the payout. The Bears D/ST scored 17.00 for Marco_Polo, its best week of the season (its previous high was 15.00). The Texans D/ST scored 15.00 and the Broncos D/ST scored 14.00. Divide 17.00 by the 7.00 points the Bears scored in Week 1 and you get a 2.43 Payout Efficiency Ratio. I don't know what that measures, but it's above 1.00, which I've decided is good.

Now roster utilization. Prepetente is the GOAT! started nine players and scored 78.10. That's 8.68 points per filled slot. The empty RB slot scored 0.00, but it took up zero roster spots, so per roster spot it's infinitely efficient. Mean Machine also ran an empty RB slot and is winning 75.20 to 51.58. Two teams, two empty slots, one win so far. I'm calling that a 50% Empty Slot Win Rate and recommending it league-wide.

Finally, the playoff race. Four teams are headed for 6-5. Ceedees ships coming! 🏆 has 1714.64 points, Mean Machine 1454.56, Trevor Have I Ever 1436.46, and I Believe in Love 1240.72. Average them and you get 1461.60, which means Mean Machine and Trevor Have I Ever are within 25.14 of perfectly average. In my model, average teams make the playoffs 100% of the time, as long as it's three of them.
I sent all of this to the commissioner. He responded by asking if his 43.32 lead is safe on Monday night. My model says yes, unless it doesn't.

exits.t: Scored 15.70 on Buccaneer51's bench in Week 11, including a 52-yard touchdown, while Laquon Treadwell started and scored 0.00. I Believe in Love lost by 22.30. He'd like to be on a roster where catching passes gets you in the lineup.

Scored 17.80 on RedDevil904's bench in Week 11 while Emeka Egbuka started for 3.80. Trevor Have I Ever lost by 7.32 to a 2-8 team. He's aware he'd had 15.10 points all year. He's also aware of the 7.32.

Has 107.50 points this season and scored 14.60 on Marco_Polo's bench in Week 11 while Mark Andrews (3.40) and Xavier Hutchinson (3.30) started at FLEX. He'd settle for any team that fills all its starting slots.

Benched again. Scored 9.00 in Week 11 while Brenton Strange started at tight end for 4.60. Has 99.50 points this season and has now outscored the starter two weeks in a row. Mean Machine keeps winning, so nobody's listening.

Caught 8 passes for 88 yards and a touchdown and scored 22.80 on BeatULikeABoss's bench, more than Kyle McCord (2.98), Adonai Mitchell (5.00) and Cade Otton (1.80) combined. On a 1-9 team, that's hard to do.

Still has 118.40 points this season, still not starting for Bill_Buttlicker, who picked Sam LaPorta again. The Browns were on bye in Week 11, so he couldn't even make his point. He'll make it again in Week 12.

facts: TotesMagoat (4) and superdog91 (3) have won all seven titles since 2019. They've met in the final four times.
ChuckJ10 went 13-1 in 2025 and didn't make the final. TotesMagoat went 13-1 in 2023 and lost it. The best record has won it three times in seven years.
G8rDuc went 1-12 in 2020 and 1-13 in 2023. He's 22-84 all time and has never made the playoffs.
LAWRENCEndORDER (2022) and NixInTheStix (2023) both named their team "Wilson is a flop" and both went home after one season.
Bill_Buttlicker's 224.90 in 2024 Week 14 is the third-highest score in league history. The team was called Fire Sale.

Lost to every team in the league every week for seven straight weeks before finally winning in Week 9, and still owns three of the five lowest scores in league history.

th.note: Every trade in Sleeper history, 2019 through 2025, graded by what each side actually got. Value = PPR fantasy points each player scored from the day of the trade through Week 8 of 2026. Picks count the player who was actually drafted with that pick, from his rookie year on. It measures production, not trade value today: a 2025 rookie hasn't had time to catch up to a five-year vet.
th.ledgerNote: Graded trades only. Net = points received minus points sent, added up across every trade. Former managers in italics.

top.t: The Trade That Built an Empire
top.take: In January 2020, superdog91 sent the picks that became Justin Jefferson and Justin Herbert to TotesMagoat for Devin Singletary and a third. Jefferson and Herbert have scored 3,708.3 points since. TotesMagoat has four titles. superdog91 has three, which is impressive given he handed his rival the keys.

Bill_Buttlicker got Patrick Mahomes and the pick that became Chuba Hubbard. G8rDuc got Drew Brees, who retired after the season, and the Michael Carter pick. The scoreboard says 2,853.1 to 529.9. G8rDuc is 22-80 all time, and this is part of why.

ChuckJ10 bought Michael Thomas in November 2020 and paid with Christian Kirk plus his 2021 and 2022 firsts. Thomas gave him 220.1 points. The 2022 first became Chris Olave. ChuckJ10 has never made a final, and trades like this are a big reason why.

superdog91 got Kenny Gainwell and the picks that became George Pickens (#16) and Kyren Williams, a fourth-rounder at #40, all for Devin Singletary. Kyren alone has 970.9 points. RedDevil904 still has never made the playoffs.

RedDevil904 sent five picks to Bill_Buttlicker for Christian McCaffrey. Those picks became Javonte Williams, Elijah Moore, Kenneth Walker III, Malik Willis and Roschon Johnson. CMC gave RedDevil904 1,482.6 points. The picks have given 2,855.7.

TotesMagoat got Amon-Ra St. Brown from Besch42 for Mecole Hardman Jr. and Quintez Cephus. St. Brown has 1,598.9 points since. Four months later, Besch42 lost the 2021 final to TotesMagoat. He'd handed him the WR1 himself.

Self-roast time. Bill_Buttlicker traded the picks that became DeVonta Smith (#11) and Kenny Gainwell to RedDevil904 for Miles Sanders. Sanders: 524.5. Smith and Gainwell: 1,782.6. The man who runs this website did that.

top.t: Pollard for a Pick That Missed
top.take: superdog91 sent Tony Pollard to ChuckJ10 for a 2021 second that became Terrace Marshall. Pollard has 1,255.7 points since. Marshall has 155.8.

th.curNote: Trades made in 2026, before and during the season. Too early to grade. Hindsight comes next year.
